en.headline: Firefighters rescue boy, 13, from Kwun Tong flat fire
en.dek: A blaze at Tsui Ping (North) Estate sent a boy onto an air-conditioner ledge; he was taken to hospital conscious.
body: Firefighters rescued a 13-year-old boy from a flat fire at Tsui To House, Tsui Ping (North) Estate in Kwun Tong on Wednesday evening, after he climbed out and waited on an external air-conditioning unit.

Police said they received reports at about 7:54pm of a fire in an upper-floor flat, with smoke and what callers described as an explosion sound. The Fire Services Department deployed one hose, a breathing-apparatus team and an aerial ladder. The blaze was put out at about 8:25pm, according to reports of the operation.

The boy was conscious when firefighters brought him back inside and was taken to United Christian Hospital. About 70 people left the building on their own during the incident, police and firefighters said. The cause of the fire was still under investigation.

The Housing Department and the fire services had not, by late evening, given a public account of how the fire started. Residents were reported to have gathered on the ground floor while crews worked on the flat.

zh.headline: 觀塘翠屏北邨單位起火 13歲男童獲救送院
zh.dek: 翠桃樓晚上近八時火警，男童一度蹲在外牆冷氣機上，清醒後送往聯合醫院，約70人自行疏散。
body: 觀塘翠屏北邨翠桃樓一個單位星期三晚上起火，一名13歲男童一度爬出窗外、蹲在外牆冷氣機上，其後獲消防人員救回屋內，清醒送往聯合醫院。
警方說，晚上約7時54分接獲多人報案，指高樓單位火警，現場冒煙，報案人並稱曾聽到爆炸聲。消防出動一條喉、一隊煙帽隊及雲梯灌救，火勢約於晚上8時25分救熄。
據警方及消防所述，火警期間約70人自行疏散到樓下。起火原因仍在調查，房屋署及消防至晚上仍未公布火種來源。
現場單位外牆熏黑，有居民在地下暫避。當局未有公布男童姓名，事件沒有其他傷者的官方數字。
